cards.front: Recall a key point about Paper 1: Myth & Religion Technique

cards.back: 1. For Paper 1: Myth & Religion Technique, use classical terminology and reference specific ancient sources 2. When analysing texts, consider both content and literary techniques 3. For essay questions, structure your argument with clear topic sentences and supporting evidence
